name: Phaser
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: 2D HTML5 game framework with its own loop, scenes, tweens and Arcade/Matter physics
summary: Full 2D game framework on WebGL/Canvas: scene manager, sprites, tilemaps, cameras, tween system and two physics engines. Driven from JavaScript in a browser page; output is canvas pixels. Its strength is a complete game loop with assets and input, which VCR does not need because it seeks by time rather than plays.
use_when: Replaying an existing Phaser game or scene as footage
avoid_when: Seekable 2D scenes: PixiJS with a GSAP timeline gives deterministic frames
Physics-only motion: Matter.js is smaller and steppable by hand
3D or editor-driven games: PlayCanvas or Godot

assessment.rationale: Active (v4.2.1, July 2026) but its real-time game loop is hostile to frame-exact capture, and rendering duplicates PixiJS while physics duplicates Matter.js, both catalogued. No incremental route for an agent.

notes: 2026-10-26: deterministic manual stepping in v4 not verified.
